en: The only thing I'm certain about is that Supervoids trigger my fight-or-flight instinct.
This pin looks sickening enough, yet the planet it depicts is a lot worse!
I don't know much about Halloween. I remember it involves some candy-gathering ritual.
It's just a pin of a voltage planet. Thankfully, unlike the real deal, it's not electrified.
You can never be sure what horrors lie in the eternal darkness of abyss planets. Stay vigilant.
My fur alone won't keep me safe from the cold this time. Permafrost planets are not very forgiving.
The air on those raging inferno planets is literally burning. My fur doesn't stand a chance.
Landing in a nuclear wasteland sounds like a one-way trip. And not the one worth taking.
